Job description:

Spyder Industries Australia PTY LTD is hiring a Full-time System Analyst role in Collie, Western Australia. Apply now to become part of our team.

Requirements for this role

Flexible hours available
Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience required for this role
Relevant work rights for Australia
Work location: In person
Spyder Industries Australia PTY LTD is looking for an experienced System Analyst to support the company’s ICT systems and business operations at our Collie, Western Australia location.

On a full-time basis, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary and well-supported team, consulting with business users and technical stakeholders to evaluate existing ICT systems, identify operational requirements, and recommend practical system improvements.

Position Title: System Analyst
ANZSCO Occupation: Systems Analyst – ANZSCO 261112
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: AU$90,000.00 to AU$98,000.00 per year plus superannuation
Work Location: In person

About the Role

The System Analyst will evaluate the processes, procedures, and methods used in the company’s existing ICT systems and recommend modifications, additional system components, integrations, or new systems to meet operational and user requirements.

The successful applicant will work closely with management, business users, developers, vendors, and ICT support personnel to gather requirements, prepare system specifications, coordinate system testing, and support the implementation of reliable and effective technology solutions.

Requirements

Applicants should demonstrate the following:

Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as a System Analyst, Systems Analyst, ICT Business Analyst, or in a closely related ICT systems role
Relevant qualification in Information Systems, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or an equivalent field
Strong understanding of ICT systems, business processes, system workflows, and operational requirements
Experience consulting with users to gather, analyse, formulate, and document business and system requirements
Experience evaluating existing systems, business processes, procedures, and work practices
Ability to identify system limitations, operational inefficiencies, integration issues, and areas for improvement
Experience preparing functional specifications, system requirement documents, workflow diagrams, process models, data models, and technical documentation
Experience supporting system implementation, integration, configuration, testing, and deployment activities
Understanding of system testing, user acceptance testing, defect tracking, quality assurance, and change management processes
Experience with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, ServiceNow, Google Workspace, enterprise resource planning systems, customer relationship management systems, or similar business platforms
Ability to prepare user guides, training materials, system procedures, technical reports, and operational documentation
Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical users
Good analytical, problem-solving, organisational, and project coordination skills
Strong attention to detail and commitment to system quality, data integrity, and continuous improvement
Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team
Responsibilities

The System Analyst’s responsibilities will include:

Consult with users, managers, clients, and technical stakeholders to understand operational needs and formulate clear business and system requirements.
Analyse existing ICT systems, business processes, procedures, workflows, and work practices to identify limitations, inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Evaluate the processes and methods used in existing ICT systems and recommend modifications, additional system components, integrations, or new systems.
Translate user and business requirements into clear functional specifications and system documentation for developers, vendors, and ICT support teams.
Use data modelling, process modelling, workflow mapping, and other analysis techniques to prepare clear system specifications.
Develop business requirement documents, functional requirement specifications, system process diagrams, data flow diagrams, process notes, and implementation documentation.
Review proposed system solutions to ensure they meet business requirements, operational objectives, technical standards, and user expectations.
Work closely with developers, ICT support teams, external vendors, and business users throughout system design, configuration, implementation, and support activities.
Assist with the preparation, adoption, and implementation of system test plans to ensure acceptable system quality, functionality, reliability, and data integrity.
Coordinate and support system testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing, issue identification, defect tracking, and resolution.
Monitor system implementation activities and confirm that approved requirements and functional specifications have been correctly delivered.
Assess system functionality and user feedback and recommend improvements to system usability, performance, workflows, and business processes.
Review and improve user access procedures, account management processes, permission controls, shared data structures, and business application workflows.
Support the deployment of functional ICT solutions and assist users during system transitions, upgrades, and process changes.
Prepare user guides, system procedures, operating instructions, training materials, and technical support documentation.
Deliver system training and provide practical guidance to staff and other business users.
Act as a central source of information and provide advice and assistance during system-related planning and decision-making.
Maintain accurate system records, configuration information, issue registers, testing records, and operational reports.
Monitor system performance, service requests, recurring user issues, and operational incidents to support reliable day-to-day business operations.
Assist with system-related onboarding and offboarding processes, including user account access, permissions, application access, and system usage guidance.
Maintain clear communication with stakeholders and provide practical technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, system functionality, and user experience.
Perform other related system analysis and ICT project duties as reasonably required.
Application

If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and submit an up-to-date CV.

Shortlisted applicants will be contacted to arrange a suitable time to discuss the position, their experience, and their suitability for the role.

Work Location: In person

Experience Strategist (also known as CX or UX strategist, CRM strategist)
The CX strategist is a problem-solving thinker delivering business insights through understanding audiences, developing data-led decisions, customer experiences and strategy direction. Day-to-day they concentrate on guiding strategy across key accounts while delivering industry-leading service, which includes: Analyzing a variety of data-centric resources, hacking data, researching behaviours, looking at what people are doing and hypothesizing why. Building consumer personas, identifying pain points and mapping experience journeys to envision brand experiences across web, mobile, AI, CRM and other interfaces. Work with clients to quickly develop clear and detailed briefs across relevant channels. Micro-journey planning:  documenting workshops and creating design artefacts such as storyboards, as-is and future-state journey flows to help clients understand the best solution for the customer.

Salary – Over threshold

Roles could also be available in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane

Role Purpose

The ICT Business Development Manager will identify, develop and manage commercial opportunities for ICT and digital business solutions. The role is responsible for understanding client technology requirements, promoting ICT services, preparing solution proposals, managing client relationships, and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders to support successful delivery of digital and technology-enabled business solutions.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

Identify and develop new business opportunities for ICT, digital transformation, software, web, automation, IT support and business process technology services.
Research target markets, industry trends, competitor activity and client requirements to support ICT business growth strategies.
Engage with prospective and existing clients to understand ICT needs, operational challenges and opportunities for technology-enabled improvement.
Prepare ICT solution proposals, presentations, business cases, quotes and service scope documents in consultation with technical and management teams.
Promote the organisation's ICT and digital services to clients, partners and stakeholders through professional consultation and relationship management.
Manage the business development pipeline, including lead generation, qualification, follow-up, negotiation support and conversion reporting.
Coordinate with technical teams, consultants, vendors and service partners to ensure proposed ICT solutions are commercially viable and deliverable.
Support contract discussions, client onboarding, implementation planning and post-sale client relationship management for ICT service engagements.
Maintain CRM records, sales forecasts, client communication records and management reports relating to ICT business development activities.
Develop strategic partnerships and referral channels for ICT services, digital solutions, remote staffing, outsourcing and business process support.
Monitor project and client feedback to identify service improvements, renewal opportunities and additional ICT solution requirements.
Ensure business development activities comply with company policies, ethical standards and applicable employment, privacy and commercial obligations.
Required Experience

Minimum five (5) years of professional experience in business development, sales, client relationship management, management consulting, project coordination or a closely related commercial role.
At least two (2) years of the total experience must be closely related to ICT business development, ICT sales, digital solutions, technology services, software/web solutions, IT outsourcing, business process technology or digital transformation services.
Demonstrated experience identifying client ICT needs, preparing commercial proposals and supporting the sale or delivery of ICT/digital services.
Experience working with technical teams, vendors, consultants or project delivery teams to translate client requirements into practical ICT service solutions.
Experience using CRM systems, market research, sales reporting, stakeholder management and business communication tools.
Required Qualifications and Skills

Bachelor degree or higher in Business, Management, Marketing, Information Technology, Digital Business, Project Management or a closely related field. An MBA or postgraduate business qualification is highly regarded.
Strong understanding of ICT services, digital transformation, technology-enabled business solutions and commercial proposal development.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare professional proposals, reports and client presentations.
Strong analytical, negotiation, stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and coordinate with internal and external teams in a professional environment.
Selection Criteria

Proven ability to generate and manage ICT-related business development opportunities.
Strong commercial understanding of client needs, solution scoping and ICT service delivery requirements.
Ability to build long-term client relationships and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated capacity to prepare high-quality proposals, reports and business cases for ICT/digital services.
Ability to contribute to business growth, market expansion and service improvement strategies.
Employment Conditions

This is a full-time position based in Canberra, ACT. Primary location: Canberra, ACT. The employee may be required to work from other Australian locations if required by the employer due to business or project needs. The employee will work 38 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Remuneration is AUD 150,000 gross per annum plus superannuation, subject to final employment agreement. The role is intended to support ongoing ICT business development and digital solutions growth for the business.

For the candidate
Full Time Contract
Hybrid location - Sydney
This is a permanent role so please only apply if you have full working rights in Australia.
No recruitment agencies please

## Technical Writer

## Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Writer to join our team and produce clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation that supports both internal operations and end-user understanding. This role is central to bridging the gap between complex technical concepts and accessible written content across a range of formats and platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong research capabilities, excellent written communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts, developers, and stakeholders. A background in a technical discipline combined with a passion for clear communication would make you an exceptional fit for this position.

## Key Responsibilities

- Research, develop, and maintain a broad range of technical documentation including user manuals, handbooks, training materials, standard operating procedures, and multimedia content

- Translate complex technical information into clear, concise, and accurate content tailored to the intended audience, whether end users, internal teams, or stakeholders

- Collaborate closely with engineers, developers, product managers, and subject matter experts to gather information and verify technical accuracy across all documentation

- Plan, organise, and manage documentation projects from initial brief through to final publication, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met

- Review and edit existing documentation to identify gaps, inconsistencies, or outdated content, and update materials to reflect product or process changes

- Develop and apply style guides, templates, and documentation standards to ensure consistency in tone, format, and terminology across all written outputs

- Produce content for digital and print formats including online help systems, knowledge bases, e-learning modules, and technical reference guides

- Liaise with stakeholders to understand documentation requirements and translate business or technical briefs into structured, reader-focused content

- Conduct quality assurance reviews of documentation prior to release, checking for technical accuracy, readability, grammar, and adherence to brand and style guidelines

- Support the development of training materials and contribute to onboarding programmes by producing clear instructional content for new users or staff

- Manage version control and document repositories, ensuring all materials are correctly filed, versioned, and accessible to relevant teams

## Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Technical Writing, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

- Demonstrated experience in a technical writing role, ideally within a corporate, technology, or engineering environment

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy

- Proven ability to research, interpret, and document complex technical subjects in a clear and accessible manner

- Proficiency in documentation tools such as MadCap Flare, Confluence, Microsoft Word, or equivalent platforms

- Experience working with content management systems, version control tools, and document repositories

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines

- Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and build effective relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Sound understanding of documentation best practices, including the use of style guides such as the Microsoft Manual of Style or equivalent

## Preferred Qualifications

- Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Technical Communication, such as a Certificate IV in Professional Writing and Editing or equivalent

- Experience with API documentation, software development lifecycle (SDLC), or working within Agile project environments

- Familiarity with graphic design or multimedia tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Snagit, or Camtasia to support visual documentation

- Exposure to single-sourcing methodologies and structured authoring frameworks such as DITA

- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare, finance, or engineering where documentation compliance is essential

## Why Join Us?

- Flexible working arrangements including hybrid and remote options to support a healthy work-life balance

- A collaborative, inclusive team culture that values expertise, continuous learning, and professional growth

- Access to ongoing training, professional development programmes, and support for further education or industry certifications

- Meaningful work that directly contributes to product quality, customer experience, and organisational knowledge

- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits reviewed annually in line with performance

## Job Details

- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift

- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
About Us

We're not like other digital marketing companies.

We are a consulting-led agency. What does that mean? It means our sole focus is driving profitable growth for our clients' businesses.

It means we are platform and channel-agnostic. We look at where clients want to go and tell them the best way to get there, even if that means taking a road less travelled.

We work with some of the world's best-known companies, including innovative scale-ups, large global brands and private equity firms, to deliver visionary yet pragmatic solutions to their unique challenges.

We (and our clients!) consider us experts in media buying & advertising, creative, SEO, social media management, content, web analytics & attribution, website development, conversion rate optimisation, and UX/UI consulting.

We service clients across Australia and the US, with most of our team based in Sydney and a number of key team members working remotely around the world. We currently operate on a hybrid model, with Tuesdays and Thursdays in the office.

Our culture is built on innovation, diversity and excellence. Most importantly, we genuinely care about each other, which makes working at Orange Line that much better.

About the Role

Reporting to the Outreach & Comms Lead, the Outreach Manager will play a key role across digital PR, outreach, content and SEO & GEO. This is a broad, hands-on role where you'll manage outreach campaigns, build client relationships and collaborate closely with the SEO & GEO team to drive meaningful results.

You'll progressively take ownership of campaigns, support the growth of the outreach function and, within your first six months, be ready to manage a junior team member while developing a strong understanding of the commercial side of the business. The role is designed to evolve around your strengths, interests and the changing agency landscape.

You Will Be Responsible For

- Managing outreach campaigns from prospecting through to content placements
- Building relationships with publishers, journalists, bloggers and website owners
- Acting as a trusted day-to-day contact for clients and presenting campaign insights
- Supporting digital PR initiatives and identifying reactive media opportunities
- Writing and editing outreach content when required
- Working closely with the Outreach & Comms Lead to grow the outreach offering
- Supporting and mentoring a junior Outreach team member
- Contributing to the commercial growth of the outreach business unit
- Collaborating with the SEO & GEO and content teams to deliver integrated campaigns

About You

- 3+ years' experience in SEO & GEO, digital PR, outreach or content marketing
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English or a related field (or equivalent experience)
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with client-facing experience
- Strong organisation and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns
- Proven ability to build lasting relationships with clients, publishers and media contacts
- Curious, proactive and commercially minded, with a willingness to take ownership
- A collaborative team player who enjoys working across different disciplines
- Kind, emotionally intelligent and genuinely invested in helping others succeed

What's in It for You

- Awesome office located 15 minutes' walk from Central Station
- A company that genuinely believes in work/life harmony and flexibility
- Permanent hybrid model with Mon/Wed/Fri working from home and Tue/Thu in the office
- Clear learning and development pathways with defined career progression
- Work with leading Australian and global brands across a diverse range of industries
- Learn alongside subject-matter experts with years of industry experience
- Monthly social events including brewery tours, boat parties, cheese making and more
- An inclusive, collaborative culture where everyone has a voice and can help shape the agency

result.description:
JBS Australia is Australia's largest and most respected meat and food processing company, employing thousands of people across the country. We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced IT Coordinator to join our team at JBS Dinmore.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about developing people, driving performance, and creating a strong culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

About the Role
As an IT Coordinator at Dinmore Plant, you will be responsible for maintaining and supporting all plant IT systems to ensure operational efficiency. This role includes installing and configuring hardware and software, performing preventative maintenance, and troubleshooting technical issues. The position requires strong problem-solving skills, effective communication with non-technical users, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment. The IT Coordinator plays a key role in minimising downtime, supporting continuous improvement, and ensuring reliable technology performance across the site. This is a full-time role with annual salary not less than $79,423.00 plus superannuation.

Your key responsibilities include:
Perform preventative and scheduled maintenance on all plant IT assets to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
Install and configure new hardware, including desktop computers and industrial printers, to support operational needs.
Deploy and configure software across multiple platforms, ensuring compatibility and functionality.
Modify, configure and customise existing software applications and system settings to meet operational requirements and improve user functionality and efficiency.
Assess software and hardware requirements and recommend appropriate technical solutions to meet operational and user needs across the plant environment.
Configure, implement and maintain local computer networks and connectivity solutions to support business systems and operational equipment.
Assist with the design, maintenance and updating of internal web-based platforms, intranet resources or business websites to support operational and communication requirements.
Monitor, diagnose, and resolve daily IT issues throughout the plant, providing timely and effective support.
Troubleshoot and resolve user-related problems as they arise, minimising downtime and disruption.
Escalate complex issues to the broader IT support team while maintaining accountability for resolution and closure.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate smooth IT operations.
Prepare reports and track data to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma plus 1 year of full-time relevant experience. Alternatively, at least 3 years of relevant experience and/or relevant vendor certification may substitute for the formal qualifications.
Previous experience working with varied IT hardware, software, and operating systems.
Ability to work autonomously as well as part of a greater team.
Highly developed interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills – with the ability to explain technical issues to a non-technical user base.
Highly developed time management skills, including prioritising tasks and meeting conflicting deadlines.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
High standard of computer literacy.
Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and diagnostic skills.
Previous experience in a food manufacturing/processing environment would be preferable.

What We Offer
Career development opportunities within a global organisation
Supportive leadership team and collaborative work environment
Access to employee benefits and wellbeing programs
Opportunity to make a genuine impact on workforce capability and employee success
Long-term career opportunities with one of Australia's leading employers
If you are passionate about developing people and want to be part of a business that values safety, teamwork and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you.

The ad is valid for 28 days.,

Apply now and help shape the future workforce at JBS Dinmore!
